name: Sri Rama Temple (Ramalayam)
significance: Holy spot where the original self-manifested idol of Sri Satyanarayanaswamy was discovered. Lord Sri Rama is revered as the Kshetra Palaka of the temple.

name: Sri Vana Durga Shrine
significance: Held in great veneration; Devi is believed to perpetually guard the Lord's holy precincts, moving about during the night.

name: Sri Kanaka Durga Shrine
significance: Revered shrine dedicated to Goddess Kanaka Durga; Chandi Homam on Mula Nakshatram and Jatara Mahotsavams are celebrated here.

name: Gramadevatha Nerellamma Temple
location: In the village at the foot of Ratnagiri hill
significance: Ancient temple of the village deity (Gramadevatha) worshipped by locals and visiting pilgrims.

name: Yantralayam & Panchayatana Peetham
location: Ground floor sanctum of the main temple
significance: Houses the Srimathripathvibhuti Vykhunta Maha Narayana Yantra along with shrines of Ganapati, Suryanarayanaswamy, Bala Tripurasundari, and Maheswaraswamy.
